description: Read recent onchain events by log polling: BlazarFeeRouter AggregatedSwap (trader, tokens, amounts, USD) or one BlazarSwap pair's Swap + Sync (reserves and price). Returns nextFromBlock to poll again. Up to 5,000 blocks per call (about 2 hours). Polygon only (chain 137).

blocks.description: Blocks to scan, max 5000. Default 900 (~30 min).

fromBlock.description: Start block (use nextFromBlock from the last call). Default: head - blocks + 1.

source.description: feeRouter: AggregatedSwap events. pair: Swap + Sync on one BlazarSwap pair.

name: blazar_recent_events
title: Recent swaps / pool events (log polling)
